_how_to_add: Each nugget is written here, in this file. Only "title" and "text" are needed. "kind" is a small label (Book, Habit, Person, Idea...), "link" is optional and only used if you want to point somewhere; add "linkText" (words from "text") to put the link on those words instead of a separate "Find it here". Put a comma after every entry except the last. Nuggets with "top": true show first, in the order they appear here; the page then mixes the rest so the same person never appears twice in a row.

nuggets.title: “The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, and wiser people so full of doubts.”
